mechanics.name: The Poisoned Needle Lock
mechanics.desc: A handsome lock on a chest-like block that bites back: a hair-fine needle in the keyhole, a drop of something green, and a delver who learns about both through the finger.
mechanics.flavor: It was the cleverest lock in the world, right up to the moment you touched it.

mechanics.name: The Poisoned Needle Lock: Sleeping Needle
mechanics.desc: A handsome lock on a chest-like block that bites back: a hair-fine needle in the keyhole, a drop of something green, and a delver who learns about both through the finger. The poison is a sleeping draught: slowness, then a heavy drowsiness.
mechanics.flavor: It was the cleverest lock in the world, right up to the moment you touched it.

mechanics.name: The Poisoned Needle Lock: Altar
mechanics.desc: A handsome lock on a chest-like block that bites back: a hair-fine needle in the keyhole, a drop of something green, and a delver who learns about both through the finger. It needs a hand on its altar block to begin.

mechanics.name: The Poisoned Needle Lock: Black Needle

mechanics.flavor: It was the cleverest lock in the world, right up to the moment you touched it.

mechanics.name: The Poisoned Needle Lock: Switch
mechanics.desc: A handsome lock on a chest-like block that bites back: a hair-fine needle in the keyhole, a drop of something green, and a delver who learns about both through the finger. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: It was the cleverest lock in the world, right up to the moment you touched it.

mechanics.name: The Rolling Boulder
mechanics.desc: A tripwire in a long hall and a rumble from behind: the delvers who do not duck are carried off down the corridor by a boulder with no particular malice and no brakes.
mechanics.flavor: Indiana Jones had a better hat. You have a worse boulder.

mechanics.name: The Rolling Boulder: The Boulder from the South
mechanics.desc: A tripwire in a long hall and a rumble from behind: the delvers who do not duck are carried off down the corridor by a boulder with no particular malice and no brakes. It rolls the other way.
mechanics.flavor: Indiana Jones had a better hat. You have a worse boulder.

mechanics.name: The Rolling Boulder: Footfall
mechanics.desc: A tripwire in a long hall and a rumble from behind: the delvers who do not duck are carried off down the corridor by a boulder with no particular malice and no brakes. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Indiana Jones had a better hat. You have a worse boulder.

mechanics.flavor: Indiana Jones had a better hat. You have a worse boulder.

mechanics.flavor: Indiana Jones had a better hat. You have a worse boulder.

mechanics.name: The Flooding Vault
mechanics.desc: The doors drop and the water comes in from the ceiling and the walls: a layer at a time, reaching the knees, then the shoulders, then the ceiling.
mechanics.flavor: Seven feet of water in a ten-foot room. Take a deep breath.

mechanics.name: The Flooding Vault: The Slow Drain
mechanics.desc: The doors drop and the water comes in from the ceiling and the walls: a layer at a time, reaching the knees, then the shoulders, then the ceiling. It fills slowly but gets deep: three layers over a minute.
mechanics.flavor: Seven feet of water in a ten-foot room. Take a deep breath.

mechanics.name: The Flooding Vault: Omen
mechanics.desc: The doors drop and the water comes in from the ceiling and the walls: a layer at a time, reaching the knees, then the shoulders, then the ceiling. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: Seven feet of water in a ten-foot room. Take a deep breath.

mechanics.name: The Flooding Vault: Switch
mechanics.desc: The doors drop and the water comes in from the ceiling and the walls: a layer at a time, reaching the knees, then the shoulders, then the ceiling. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: Seven feet of water in a ten-foot room. Take a deep breath.

mechanics.name: The Flooding Vault: The Eel Pool
mechanics.desc: The doors drop and the water comes in from the ceiling and the walls: a layer at a time, reaching the knees, then the shoulders, then the ceiling. The water is alive: a swarm of biters comes with it.
mechanics.flavor: Seven feet of water in a ten-foot room. Take a deep breath.

mechanics.name: The Flooding Vault: Clockwork
mechanics.desc: The doors drop and the water comes in from the ceiling and the walls: a layer at a time, reaching the knees, then the shoulders, then the ceiling. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
mechanics.flavor: Seven feet of water in a ten-foot room. Take a deep breath.

mechanics.flavor: Seven feet of water in a ten-foot room. Take a deep breath.

mechanics.name: The Dart Wall
mechanics.desc: Rows of tiny holes in a wall that nobody had noticed until someone looked at it too long: a click, a whistle, and a hail of darts at head height.
mechanics.flavor: Hold still. You are being looked at.

mechanics.name: The Dart Wall: Snow-Dart Wall
mechanics.desc: Rows of tiny holes in a wall that nobody had noticed until someone looked at it too long: a click, a whistle, and a hail of darts at head height. The darts are frozen shot: they chill instead of pierce.
mechanics.flavor: Hold still. You are being looked at.

mechanics.name: The Dart Wall: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: Rows of tiny holes in a wall that nobody had noticed until someone looked at it too long: a click, a whistle, and a hail of darts at head height. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: Hold still. You are being looked at.

mechanics.name: The Dart Wall: Switch
mechanics.desc: Rows of tiny holes in a wall that nobody had noticed until someone looked at it too long: a click, a whistle, and a hail of darts at head height. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.

mechanics.name: The Dart Wall: Fire-Dart Wall

mechanics.name: The Fire Jets
mechanics.desc: Hidden nozzles along the corridor open one after another in a rolling wave of flame; the old dwarves made them to guard the forge, and the forge is long gone, but the nozzles are not.
mechanics.flavor: Mind the gaps between the flames.

mechanics.name: The Fire Jets: Frost Jets
mechanics.desc: Hidden nozzles along the corridor open one after another in a rolling wave of flame; the old dwarves made them to guard the forge, and the forge is long gone, but the nozzles are not. Jets of frost: a numbing cold instead of flame.
mechanics.flavor: Mind the gaps between the flames.

mechanics.name: The Fire Jets: Footfall
mechanics.desc: Hidden nozzles along the corridor open one after another in a rolling wave of flame; the old dwarves made them to guard the forge, and the forge is long gone, but the nozzles are not. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Mind the gaps between the flames.

mechanics.flavor: Mind the gaps between the flames.

mechanics.flavor: Mind the gaps between the flames.

mechanics.name: The Sphere of Annihilation
mechanics.desc: A perfect black sphere hangs in an alcove, silent and hungry. It pulls on everything that comes near, and what it takes it does not return.
mechanics.flavor: Do not touch it. Do not even think about touching it.

mechanics.name: The Sphere of Annihilation: The Repelling Sphere
mechanics.desc: A perfect black sphere hangs in an alcove, silent and hungry. It pulls on everything that comes near, and what it takes it does not return. It pushes instead of pulling.
mechanics.flavor: Do not touch it. Do not even think about touching it.

mechanics.name: The Sphere of Annihilation: Clockwork
mechanics.desc: A perfect black sphere hangs in an alcove, silent and hungry. It pulls on everything that comes near, and what it takes it does not return. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
mechanics.flavor: Do not touch it. Do not even think about touching it.

mechanics.name: The Sphere of Annihilation: Keystone
mechanics.desc: A perfect black sphere hangs in an alcove, silent and hungry. It pulls on everything that comes near, and what it takes it does not return. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Do not touch it. Do not even think about touching it.

mechanics.name: The Sphere of Annihilation: The Draining Sphere
mechanics.desc: A perfect black sphere hangs in an alcove, silent and hungry. It pulls on everything that comes near, and what it takes it does not return. It pulls the mana out of whoever steps near.
mechanics.flavor: Do not touch it. Do not even think about touching it.

mechanics.name: The Sphere of Annihilation: Hush

mechanics.flavor: Do not touch it. Do not even think about touching it.

mechanics.name: The Crushing Ceiling
mechanics.desc: The ceiling of the hall is not as far up as it was: the door slams, the roof groans and starts to descend, and the only question is who is still under it when it arrives.
mechanics.flavor: In the third room of the tomb, the ceiling got lower. You noticed too late.

mechanics.name: The Crushing Ceiling: The Slow Roof
mechanics.desc: The ceiling of the hall is not as far up as it was: the door slams, the roof groans and starts to descend, and the only question is who is still under it when it arrives. It descends slowly and returns, giving a patient party time to dig out.
mechanics.flavor: In the third room of the tomb, the ceiling got lower. You noticed too late.

mechanics.name: The Crushing Ceiling: Omen
mechanics.desc: The ceiling of the hall is not as far up as it was: the door slams, the roof groans and starts to descend, and the only question is who is still under it when it arrives. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: In the third room of the tomb, the ceiling got lower. You noticed too late.

mechanics.flavor: In the third room of the tomb, the ceiling got lower. You noticed too late.

mechanics.name: The Crushing Ceiling: Stillness

mechanics.flavor: In the third room of the tomb, the ceiling got lower. You noticed too late.

mechanics.name: The Poison Gas Chamber
mechanics.desc: A greenish haze pours from vents the moment the doors slam: nobody drowns in it, but the lungs rebel, and every breath makes the next one harder.
mechanics.flavor: The vents are older than the walls.

mechanics.name: The Poison Gas Chamber: The Choking Dust
mechanics.desc: A greenish haze pours from vents the moment the doors slam: nobody drowns in it, but the lungs rebel, and every breath makes the next one harder. Dust rather than gas: it chokes and slows rather than poisons.
mechanics.flavor: The vents are older than the walls.

mechanics.name: The Poison Gas Chamber: Omen
mechanics.desc: A greenish haze pours from vents the moment the doors slam: nobody drowns in it, but the lungs rebel, and every breath makes the next one harder. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.

mechanics.name: The Poison Gas Chamber: Stillness

mechanics.name: The Glyph of Warding
mechanics.desc: A shimmering glyph in the floor, easy to miss: the wizard who laid it was a careful one, and what it summons is whatever the wizard was afraid of.
mechanics.flavor: Cast it, forget it, and let the unwary find it.

mechanics.name: The Glyph of Warding: Explosive Glyph
mechanics.desc: A shimmering glyph in the floor, easy to miss: the wizard who laid it was a careful one, and what it summons is whatever the wizard was afraid of. The glyph explodes instead of summoning.
mechanics.flavor: Cast it, forget it, and let the unwary find it.

mechanics.name: The Glyph of Warding: Gaze
mechanics.desc: A shimmering glyph in the floor, easy to miss: the wizard who laid it was a careful one, and what it summons is whatever the wizard was afraid of. It wakes when someone looks straight at it.
mechanics.flavor: Cast it, forget it, and let the unwary find it.

mechanics.name: The Glyph of Warding: Warded

mechanics.flavor: Cast it, forget it, and let the unwary find it.

mechanics.name: The Glyph of Warding: Fiendish Glyph
mechanics.desc: A shimmering glyph in the floor, easy to miss: the wizard who laid it was a careful one, and what it summons is whatever the wizard was afraid of. It summons fiends.
mechanics.flavor: Cast it, forget it, and let the unwary find it.

mechanics.name: The Glyph of Warding: Greed
mechanics.desc: A shimmering glyph in the floor, easy to miss: the wizard who laid it was a careful one, and what it summons is whatever the wizard was afraid of. It reacts to the use of items in its area.
mechanics.flavor: Cast it, forget it, and let the unwary find it.

mechanics.name: The Spore Cloud
mechanics.desc: A puffball the size of a barrel bursts under a careless foot and fills the passage with pale spores that make the head swim and the friends look like enemies.
mechanics.flavor: Zuggtmoy's gift to the Underdark.

mechanics.name: The Spore Cloud: Poison Spores
mechanics.desc: A puffball the size of a barrel bursts under a careless foot and fills the passage with pale spores that make the head swim and the friends look like enemies. Spores that poison.
mechanics.flavor: Zuggtmoy's gift to the Underdark.

mechanics.name: The Spore Cloud: Hush

mechanics.name: The Explosive Tags
mechanics.desc: Paper tags pasted along the wall in a pattern: stand on the wrong square and the whole line flares one after another, each blast setting off the next.
mechanics.flavor: Katsu.

mechanics.name: The Explosive Tags: Lightning Tags
mechanics.desc: Paper tags pasted along the wall in a pattern: stand on the wrong square and the whole line flares one after another, each blast setting off the next. Tags of lightning, not fire: a crack on each.
mechanics.flavor: Katsu.

mechanics.name: The Explosive Tags: Footfall
mechanics.desc: Paper tags pasted along the wall in a pattern: stand on the wrong square and the whole line flares one after another, each blast setting off the next. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Katsu.

mechanics.flavor: Katsu.

mechanics.name: The Assassin's Wire
mechanics.desc: A thread of Teigu steel strung ankle high across the hall, invisible until it is far too late: the unwary come to a violent, sliding stop, and then the pursuers step in.
mechanics.flavor: The thread cuts before you see it.

mechanics.flavor: The thread cuts before you see it.

The first snag is only a warning; from the second on, the hunters come in earnest, and a net drops round the runners.
mechanics.flavor: The thread cuts before you see it.

mechanics.name: The Thorn Garden
mechanics.desc: A garden of beautiful flowers that eat what steps on them: thorns reach out of the floor in a creeping lace, and what they touch goes numb.
mechanics.flavor: Everything beautiful on this island wants you dead.

mechanics.name: The Thorn Garden: Burning Thorns
mechanics.desc: A garden of beautiful flowers that eat what steps on them: thorns reach out of the floor in a creeping lace, and what they touch goes numb. The thorns burn.
mechanics.flavor: Everything beautiful on this island wants you dead.

mechanics.flavor: Everything beautiful on this island wants you dead.

mechanics.name: The Thorn Garden: Blossoming Thorns
mechanics.desc: A garden of beautiful flowers that eat what steps on them: thorns reach out of the floor in a creeping lace, and what they touch goes numb. Beautiful blossoms that restore a little before they bite.
mechanics.flavor: Everything beautiful on this island wants you dead.

mechanics.name: The Thorn Garden: Stillness
mechanics.desc: A garden of beautiful flowers that eat what steps on them: thorns reach out of the floor in a creeping lace, and what they touch goes numb. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Everything beautiful on this island wants you dead.

mechanics.name: The Sure-Hit Domain
mechanics.desc: A curse spirit's domain closes round the party: a barrier of its own world, and inside it every blow it throws lands. The only way out is to break the curse, or to be somewhere it has not drawn.
mechanics.flavor: Domain Expansion: no way to dodge.

mechanics.name: The Sure-Hit Domain: Slashing Domain

mechanics.flavor: Domain Expansion: no way to dodge.

mechanics.flavor: Domain Expansion: no way to dodge.

mechanics.name: The Sure-Hit Domain: Quorum
mechanics.desc: A curse spirit's domain closes round the party: a barrier of its own world, and inside it every blow it throws lands. The only way out is to break the curse, or to be somewhere it has not drawn. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
mechanics.flavor: Domain Expansion: no way to dodge.

mechanics.name: The Bomb Devil's Gift
mechanics.desc: A devil's present left on the floor: a ticking thing in a bright wrapper, a cheerful countdown, and a bang much larger than the room.
mechanics.flavor: Boom.

mechanics.name: The Bomb Devil's Gift: A Cluster of Gifts
mechanics.desc: A devil's present left on the floor: a ticking thing in a bright wrapper, a cheerful countdown, and a bang much larger than the room. A cluster: three smaller bangs.
mechanics.flavor: Boom.

mechanics.name: The Bomb Devil's Gift: Greed
mechanics.desc: A devil's present left on the floor: a ticking thing in a bright wrapper, a cheerful countdown, and a bang much larger than the room. It reacts to the use of items in its area.
mechanics.flavor: Boom.

mechanics.name: The Bomb Devil's Gift: Creeping
mechanics.desc: A devil's present left on the floor: a ticking thing in a bright wrapper, a cheerful countdown, and a bang much larger than the room. Sneak through its area long enough and it loses interest.
mechanics.flavor: Boom.

mechanics.name: The Bomb Devil's Gift: A Dud
mechanics.desc: A devil's present left on the floor: a ticking thing in a bright wrapper, a cheerful countdown, and a bang much larger than the room. A dud that fizzles with a cloud of smoke: no damage, but the smoke blinds.
mechanics.flavor: Boom.

mechanics.name: The Bomb Devil's Gift: Footfall
mechanics.desc: A devil's present left on the floor: a ticking thing in a bright wrapper, a cheerful countdown, and a bang much larger than the room. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Boom.

mechanics.name: The Wavelength of Madness
mechanics.desc: A grin hangs in the air like a smell, and the place fills with a whisper that is almost a song: the eyes cross, the knees turn to water, and the friend beside you has a very wide smile.
mechanics.flavor: Madness is a kind of music. Don't dance.

mechanics.name: The Wavelength of Madness: Dancing Madness
mechanics.desc: A grin hangs in the air like a smell, and the place fills with a whisper that is almost a song: the eyes cross, the knees turn to water, and the friend beside you has a very wide smile. It makes the party dance: a shuffling stagger from side to side.
mechanics.flavor: Madness is a kind of music. Don't dance.

mechanics.name: The Wavelength of Madness: Threshold
mechanics.desc: A grin hangs in the air like a smell, and the place fills with a whisper that is almost a song: the eyes cross, the knees turn to water, and the friend beside you has a very wide smile. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: Madness is a kind of music. Don't dance.

mechanics.name: The Wavelength of Madness: Keystone
mechanics.desc: A grin hangs in the air like a smell, and the place fills with a whisper that is almost a song: the eyes cross, the knees turn to water, and the friend beside you has a very wide smile. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Madness is a kind of music. Don't dance.

mechanics.name: The Wavelength of Madness: Muffled Madness
mechanics.desc: A grin hangs in the air like a smell, and the place fills with a whisper that is almost a song: the eyes cross, the knees turn to water, and the friend beside you has a very wide smile. A muffled whisper: only the confusion, no wound.
mechanics.flavor: Madness is a kind of music. Don't dance.

mechanics.name: The Wavelength of Madness: Stillness
mechanics.desc: A grin hangs in the air like a smell, and the place fills with a whisper that is almost a song: the eyes cross, the knees turn to water, and the friend beside you has a very wide smile. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Madness is a kind of music. Don't dance.

mechanics.name: The Cursed Spirit Nest
mechanics.desc: A knot of grudge sits in the corner of the room, feeding on fear and the sounds of running feet; when it hatches it does not do so alone.
mechanics.flavor: Where there is fear, there is a curse.

mechanics.name: The Cursed Spirit Nest: A Mother Spirit
mechanics.desc: A knot of grudge sits in the corner of the room, feeding on fear and the sounds of running feet; when it hatches it does not do so alone. One bigger spirit instead of a swarm.
mechanics.flavor: Where there is fear, there is a curse.

mechanics.name: The Cursed Spirit Nest: Hush
mechanics.desc: A knot of grudge sits in the corner of the room, feeding on fear and the sounds of running feet; when it hatches it does not do so alone. Crouching in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Where there is fear, there is a curse.

mechanics.name: The Cursed Spirit Nest: Warded
mechanics.desc: A knot of grudge sits in the corner of the room, feeding on fear and the sounds of running feet; when it hatches it does not do so alone. It is held up by wardens that spawn with it; kill them all to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Where there is fear, there is a curse.

mechanics.name: The Cursed Spirit Nest: A Burning Nest
mechanics.desc: A knot of grudge sits in the corner of the room, feeding on fear and the sounds of running feet; when it hatches it does not do so alone. The nest bursts into flame on hatching.
mechanics.flavor: Where there is fear, there is a curse.

mechanics.name: The Cursed Spirit Nest: Threshold
mechanics.desc: A knot of grudge sits in the corner of the room, feeding on fear and the sounds of running feet; when it hatches it does not do so alone. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: Where there is fear, there is a curse.

mechanics.name: The Collapsing Stalactites
mechanics.desc: The old cave is tired: now and then a stalactite as thick as a pillar lets go, with all the weight of a thousand years behind it.
mechanics.flavor: The Abyss is patient. And impatient, depending on the day.

mechanics.name: The Collapsing Stalactites: The Collapsing Floor
mechanics.desc: The old cave is tired: now and then a stalactite as thick as a pillar lets go, with all the weight of a thousand years behind it. The floor goes too: a shallow pit opens under the party.
mechanics.flavor: The Abyss is patient. And impatient, depending on the day.

mechanics.name: The Collapsing Stalactites: Footfall
mechanics.desc: The old cave is tired: now and then a stalactite as thick as a pillar lets go, with all the weight of a thousand years behind it. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: The Abyss is patient. And impatient, depending on the day.

mechanics.name: The Collapsing Stalactites: Switch
mechanics.desc: The old cave is tired: now and then a stalactite as thick as a pillar lets go, with all the weight of a thousand years behind it. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: The Abyss is patient. And impatient, depending on the day.

mechanics.name: The Collapsing Stalactites: The Rockfall
mechanics.desc: The old cave is tired: now and then a stalactite as thick as a pillar lets go, with all the weight of a thousand years behind it. A fall of rubble, not a single stone: a heavier blast.
mechanics.flavor: The Abyss is patient. And impatient, depending on the day.

mechanics.name: The Collapsing Stalactites: Hush
mechanics.desc: The old cave is tired: now and then a stalactite as thick as a pillar lets go, with all the weight of a thousand years behind it. Crouching in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: The Abyss is patient. And impatient, depending on the day.

mechanics.name: The Weight of Reiatsu
mechanics.desc: A captain's spirit pressure fills a hall: the air thickens, the knees buckle, and anybody not strong enough to bear it will not be able to stand.
mechanics.flavor: You can only stand because he allows it.

mechanics.name: The Weight of Reiatsu: Crushing Reiatsu
mechanics.desc: A captain's spirit pressure fills a hall: the air thickens, the knees buckle, and anybody not strong enough to bear it will not be able to stand. Strong enough to force every delver to their knees.
mechanics.flavor: You can only stand because he allows it.

mechanics.name: The Weight of Reiatsu: Clockwork
mechanics.desc: A captain's spirit pressure fills a hall: the air thickens, the knees buckle, and anybody not strong enough to bear it will not be able to stand. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
mechanics.flavor: You can only stand because he allows it.

mechanics.name: The Weight of Reiatsu: Keystone
mechanics.desc: A captain's spirit pressure fills a hall: the air thickens, the knees buckle, and anybody not strong enough to bear it will not be able to stand. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: You can only stand because he allows it.

mechanics.name: The Weight of Reiatsu: Hollow Reiatsu
mechanics.desc: A captain's spirit pressure fills a hall: the air thickens, the knees buckle, and anybody not strong enough to bear it will not be able to stand. The pressure of a Hollow: it eats at mana as well.
mechanics.flavor: You can only stand because he allows it.

mechanics.name: The Weight of Reiatsu: Backlash
mechanics.desc: A captain's spirit pressure fills a hall: the air thickens, the knees buckle, and anybody not strong enough to bear it will not be able to stand. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
mechanics.flavor: You can only stand because he allows it.

mechanics.name: The Gravity Sink
mechanics.desc: A pocket of the floor is far heavier than it has any right to be: everything near it is dragged down, then slung out sideways when the sink lets go.
mechanics.flavor: A little piece of the abyss, installed at floor level.

mechanics.name: The Gravity Sink: The Gravity Spout
mechanics.desc: A pocket of the floor is far heavier than it has any right to be: everything near it is dragged down, then slung out sideways when the sink lets go. The pocket pushes everything up and away.
mechanics.flavor: A little piece of the abyss, installed at floor level.

mechanics.name: The Gravity Sink: Stillness
mechanics.desc: A pocket of the floor is far heavier than it has any right to be: everything near it is dragged down, then slung out sideways when the sink lets go. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: A little piece of the abyss, installed at floor level.

mechanics.name: The Gravity Sink: Anchored
mechanics.desc: A pocket of the floor is far heavier than it has any right to be: everything near it is dragged down, then slung out sideways when the sink lets go. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
mechanics.flavor: A little piece of the abyss, installed at floor level.

mechanics.name: The Gravity Sink: Dense Time
mechanics.desc: A pocket of the floor is far heavier than it has any right to be: everything near it is dragged down, then slung out sideways when the sink lets go. A pocket of dense time: slow instead of heavy.
mechanics.flavor: A little piece of the abyss, installed at floor level.

mechanics.name: The Gravity Sink: Greed
mechanics.desc: A pocket of the floor is far heavier than it has any right to be: everything near it is dragged down, then slung out sideways when the sink lets go. It reacts to the use of items in its area.
mechanics.flavor: A little piece of the abyss, installed at floor level.
